f.n: Área Marinha da Baixa da Barca
f.pu: The purpose of management in the Área Marinha da Baixa da Barca is to protect the marine environment by restricting commercial and recreational fishing activities within the designated area.
f.re: In the marine area of Baixa da Barca, the exercise of all commercial and leisure fishing is prohibited.
f.rn: Portaria n.º 53/2016 de 21 de Junho de 2016
f.ma: Secretaria Regional do Mar, Ciência e Tecnologia; Direção Regional das Pescas

f.pu: To protect the aesthetic and natural values ​​in the area, the importance of the area for species, protected habitats and ecosystems.
f.re: In the Caldeirinhas Nature Reserve, the following acts and activities are prohibited: 1. Free access by the public and boats; 2. Fishing and spearfishing; 3. Depositing waste; 4. Alteration of the seabed; 5. The performance of any activities that disturb the balance of the environment.
